newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka says to rehabilitate Tamil rebels in north.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka says to rehabilitate Tamil rebels in north.

text.p: The Sri Lankan government plans to open a rehabilitation centre for detained Tamil Tiger rebels in the northern Jaffna peninsula, a government official was quoted as saying in a Sunday newspaper.

The decision follows appeals from detainees and their families for a rehabilitation camp in Jaffna which would allow relatives more frequent visits, Commissioner-General of Rehabilitation, Kumari Navaratne, told the Sunday Island.
The government currently runs two rehabilitation camps in the island's south for members of the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam, who have either been captured or have surrendered, she said.
Government officials were not immediately available for comment.
Human rights groups say prisoners often must spend years in detention before being released or tried.

The rebels are fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in the north and east. The government says more than 50,000 people have died in the war, now in its 14th year. The rebels say the toll is higher.
